Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 나와 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>의 인연에 여교황 아르카나의 축복이 깃들었다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: The bond between <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> and me has been blessed by the High Priestess Arcana.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 私と<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の絆に、アルカナ「女教皇」の祝福が宿った。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我与<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的缘分获得了女教皇阿尔克那的祝福。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 我與<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的緣分獲得了女教皇阿爾克那的祝福。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Le lien entre <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> et moi a été béni par l'Arcana, la Grande Prêtresse.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: „Die Bindung zwischen <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> und mir wurde von der Hohepriesterin Arkana gesegnet.“
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: El vínculo entre <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> y yo ha sido bendecido por la Suma Sacerdotisa Arcana.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: O laço entre <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> e eu foi abençoado pela Papisa Arcana.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: สายสัมพันธ์ของฉันกับ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ได้รับพรจากสังฆราชินีอาร์คานา
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Ikatan antara aku dan <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> telah diberkati oleh Imamah Agung Arcana.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Mối duyên giữa tôi và <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã được Nữ Giáo Hoàng Arcana ban phước.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मेरे और <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> के बीच का रिश्ता हाई प्रीस्टेस आर्काना का आशीर्वाद पा गया है।
